mutations.cell: the not-built message tells an installed package it is a broken install and how to reinstall it

mutations.name: the theme boot script is not served, so the page loads in the system palette

mutations.cell: the theme boot script the page loads in its head is served as JavaScript, and not cached for good, since its name carries no hash

mutations.expectRed: the theme boot script the page loads in its head is served as JavaScript, and not cached for good, since its name carries no hash
mutations.cell: the theme boot script the page loads in its head is served as JavaScript, and not cached for good, since its name carries no hash
